contributions.detail: 79 rows (57 on the 'Contributions - #1' sheet, 22 on 'Contributions - #2') sum to exactly $17,880.00 = the filer's own printed 'Total' row at the foot of sheet #2 = cover line 1 THIS = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE. LAST is blank, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide. THE SUB-$50 TRAP DOES NOT BITE HERE AND IT IS WORTH SAYING WHY: cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is BLANK in all three columns, and the filer itemised EVERY contribution including many under $50 ($5, $10, $13, $20, $25, $27, $30, $32, $35, $38, $40, $45) into the single total he then wrote on line 1. So line 1 here is not an over-$50-only figure; it is the whole ledger, and the rows match it to the cent. Rows were still scored against line 1 alone, per the contract.

expenditures.detail: 13 rows on the 'Expenses' sheet sum to exactly $17,838.37 = the sheet's own printed 'Total' row = cover line 3 THIS and CUMULATIVE. LAST is blank; only report of the cycle, so the scopes coincide.

gates.page_subtotal: p2+p3 79 rows = the filer's printed Total $17,880.00 EXACT (the Total row sits at the foot of p3 and covers BOTH contribution sheets - p2 carries no subtotal of its own, so the two pages were gated jointly). p4 13 rows = printed Total $17,838.37 EXACT. NOTE the p3 Total cell is CLIPPED at the column edge in the scan and renders '$17,880.0(' - the trailing character is cut off by the cell border, not illegible; the cover's line-1 cells print 17,880.00 twice and the row sum equals 17,880.00, so the figure is settled by two independent anchors.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py has no boxed grid to score on the cover, and the attachment sheets are faint-ruled spreadsheet prints. Counted ink with a dark-pixel projection over each sheet's Amount column: p2 returns 58 bands = 1 header + 57 data rows; p3 returns 23 bands = 22 data rows + 1 Total row (p3 does not repeat the header); p4 returns 15 bands = 1 header + 13 data + 1 Total. 79 contribution rows and 13 expenditure rows emitted - matches every count, and both totals close to the cent.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 first-row crop renders 'Nicole | Hadley | $10.00 | 3/30/2016 Paypal | ... | St George | UT'; row-57 crop renders 'Megan | Honer-Orton | $100.00 | 5/25/2016 Cash | ... | Rockville | UT'; control one row-pitch below row 57 renders EMPTY. p3 row-22 crop renders 'Lisa | Rutherford | $200.00 | 11/1/2016 Paypal'; the control one pitch below renders the 'Total $17,880.0(' line, i.e. the data grid has ended. p4 first-row crop renders 'Washington County Clerk | Filing Fee | $425.00 | 3/17/2016 Personal Check'; row-13 crop renders 'St. George News | Online Advertising | $400.00 | 10/31/2016 Debit Card'; control below renders an EMPTY grid row.
gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly: 17,880.00 - 17,838.37 = 41.63, and the cover prints 41.63 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells of line 4 (written as '41' with a superscript '63'). Line 4 LAST is blank and the Gen-1 form has no beginning-balance field. Only one filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run.

escalation_note: 600 dpi band crops for the geometry proof on all three attachment sheets (first row, last row, control); 600 dpi crops of the p2 and p3 Town/City columns to settle four look-alike spellings ('St Goerge', 'Springdele', 'Sprindale', and the genuinely different 'Dammeron Valley' on p2 vs 'Dammaron Valley' on p3).
notes: THIS FILING HAS NO FORM A AND NO FORM B. Page 1 is the Generation 1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG cover (cites Utah Code 17-16-6.5) and it directs the reader to 'form A on page 2' and 'form B on page 3', but the filer did not use them: pages 2-4 are his own printed spreadsheets, hand-titled 'Contributions - #1', 'Contributions - #2' and 'Expenses'. They are RICHER than the statutory schedules - they carry a Method column (Cash/Check/Paypal/In Kind) and an explicit In Kind marking that the Gen-1 form has no field for - and each ends in the filer's own printed Total. Sides are recorded as 'transcribed', not 'none': the itemisation exists, it is simply on the filer's paper. The cover also says 'The law is also printed on page four of this report'; page four is the Expenses sheet, so there is no statute page in this PDF. Chunk file says candidate 'Joshua Elijah Warburton', office 'Commission (seat not stated)'. The cover reads 'Joshua Elijah Warburton' and Name of Office 'Washington County Commissioner' with the Office District line BLANK - both AGREE, including the absence of a seat. County office, in scope. Political Party: 'Unaffiliated'. Cover date 11/1/16; RECEIVED stamp NOV 01 2016. SIX ROWS ARE 'Anonymous' CASH with no name, address or ZIP (totalling $235.00). They are transcribed as printed with donor_raw 'Anonymous' - an honest property of the source, not a redaction and not a gap. THE LARGEST SINGLE ITEM IS DOUBLE-BOOKED BY DESIGN: The Independent's $12,130.00 appears as an In Kind CONTRIBUTION (p3) and as an In Kind EXPENDITURE (p4) on the same 10/31/2016 date, which is why the cycle nets to $41.63. A naive cross-side sum of this filing will double-count that amount; both rows are marked in_kind true. The candidate contributed to himself three times ($5, $50, $250). Donor street addresses, PO boxes and ZIPs printed on the sheets were discarded at read time; the candidate's own home street address, ZIP and both phone numbers on the cover likewise.
